newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nac plans to list on Tokyo second section.
newsitem.headline: Nac plans to list on Tokyo second section.

text.p: Nac Co Ltd plans to list its shares on the second section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange (TSE) on January 28, the exchange said on Wednesday.
Its shares are now traded in the over-the-counter market.
The company offers various services for homes and offices, including cleaning services and plant leasing, the TSE said in a statement.
At the time of the listing, the company will offer 550,000 shares through a secondary offering, the TSE said.
